source.description:
Handoff for session ending 2026-06-14.

**SSOT report:** `.xtrm/reports/2026-06-14-978d9b0.md`

Read the report first — it has the full summary, problems, open issues with context, and the ordered next-priority list. This bead is the live pointer into the board.

**This session in one line:** folded all 9 premortem reasons from `docs/premortem-substrate/` into substrate canon across 8 documents; every owned-by link now has corresponding content in the target; closed xtrm-1jp (5th coordinator role).

**Suggested next priorities (from report §Suggested Next Priority):**
1. **substrate_design_en.md sync** — STALE per MOC, further diverged this session (~9 new sections in IT); separate sync project, needs its own bead. Recommend filing before starting.
2. **xtrm-1jp follow-on: implement design.review pre-commit gate** — substrate top-of-doc revision protocol (R9) requires this gate before any rev-13+ canonical doc merge. Forensic family declared in forensic-event-contract.md §6 today; needs xt doctor wiring.
3. **Stage 4.5: node-coordinator delivery demo** — added to substrate §15 today as blocking dependency for Stages 9+10 and any research-node work. Demo scope: one coordinator reads pulse, opens child container, journalizes, survives restart, respects deny, exercises failure_budget.
4. **xtrm-8fo** — SSH commit signing + branch protection, ops/governance hygiene, can land any session.

No follow-up beads filed yet for priorities 1–3 (they were surfaced this session) — recommend filing them as the first work of the next session, linked discovered-from this handoff.
